title: Golden provenance gate accepts stale, unrelated justifications when hashes are re-authorized
mechanism: The gate validates only that reason is a string of at least eight characters and that the current content hash matches. Commit ed2ca565 changed both authorized intent-output-p2pkh hashes for a different compiler/typecheck change while retaining reasons that attribute the bytes to #116. The gate reports the new bytes justified.
consequence: A reviewer can re-stamp an implementation-produced golden, update only sha256, and receive a green provenance result without recording or independently verifying why the new output is correct.
proposed_fix: Require a fresh provenance record for each authorization (new immutable entry ID/change commit), reject hash changes without a changed reason/verification evidence, and disallow intentional-spec-change unless the entry pins a co-changed spec section or external decision record.

title: ecMul and ecMulGen return the zero point for scalar 2
mechanism: The 257-round Jacobian double-and-add ladder conditionally invokes an add-affine path that cannot handle the accumulator equalling the affine addend. Scalar 2 reaches this doubling case and converts the broken Jacobian result to the all-zero affine point.
consequence: Contracts using ecMul(P, 2) or ecMulGen(2) compile successfully and agree across tiers but evaluate the wrong group element; the shipped ec-unit locking script is unspendable.
proposed_fix: Implement a complete Jacobian add/double selection for equal points (and infinity), then add executed KATs for scalars 0,1,2,3,n-1,n and make the ec-unit real-script spend mandatory.

title: All 47 intentional-spec-change provenance entries lack a matching written specification change
repro: git log --all --format='%H %s' --grep='#116\|#121' && git log --all --format='%H %s' -- spec && node conformance/scripts/check-golden-provenance.mjs --files conformance/tests/bounded-loop/expected-ir.json --json
mechanism: The category is accepted from a hash, an enum string, a free-form reason and reviewer marker; it is not coupled to a spec path or spec diff. Forty-three current entries are #116 output re-stamps with no spec commit, bounded-loop's #121 output contradicts the still-count-only specification, two hashes were later changed under stale #116 reasons, and the script-size entry no longer matches the target file.
consequence: Implementation output can become the de facto language definition by re-stamping self-produced goldens; seven-tier parity then amplifies the same implementation decision without an independent semantic authority.
proposed_fix: Remove self-attesting intentional-spec-change authorization. Require a co-changed normative spec section or immutable external decision record whose identifier and content hash are validated, and globally validate every live allowlist hash.

title: Six of eight differential-oracle provenance entries do not execute the exact authorized value
repro: pnpm --filter runar-testing test -- ec-add-doubling.test.ts && node audits/v1-review/codex/repro/ecmul-k2.mjs
mechanism: The selector IR entry cites an execution harness that consumes script, not expected-ir.json. Each of five EC entries cites a unit test that constructs and executes a fresh synthetic emitEcAdd method, not any listed fixture script. The ec-unit exact script also contains the still-broken ecMul(2) path and is unspendable.
consequence: A primitive-local passing test can authorize arbitrary unrelated bytes in a full fixture golden, including a fixture with another known fatal path; the provenance label overstates independent verification of the content hash.
proposed_fix: Make the provenance checker require machine-readable oracle evidence binding the exact SHA-256 to an executed artifact/result. Split IR provenance from script execution and require exact fixture execution for script entries.

title: Skip auditor does not discover generic JUnit EnabledIf gates
mechanism: The Java skip regex recognizes Assumptions, Disabled, EnabledIfEnvironmentVariable and EnabledIfSystemProperty but not JUnit's generic @EnabledIf. The existing analyzer gate is therefore invisible; its inventory row has no parseable file:line and is also omitted from the reported row count, yet the auditor exits green.
consequence: A Java test can be conditionally disabled with @EnabledIf without inventory coverage or a lint failure, turning a missing/failing test into green CI outside the documented skip machinery.
proposed_fix: Discover all JUnit conditional annotations including @EnabledIf/@DisabledIf and require every inventory row to carry a parseable, live file:line; make physical and parsed row counts agree.

title: Skip inventory labels two deferred coverage defects as environmental and claims no gaps
mechanism: The auditor checks only that skip syntax is documented and a referenced site remains live; it never validates the category or rationale. Higher-arity/per-query FRI testing is explicitly deferred to a later dispatch, and seven supported SLH-DSA examples are excluded because the lifter has pathological complexity, yet both rows are Environmental and the document asserts no gaps.
consequence: Real untested semantic shapes are presented as fully justified environmental skips, obscuring absent FRI transcript/folding coverage and decompiler regressions on supported crypto scripts.
proposed_fix: Add an enforceable deferred-defect category with issue IDs and expiry/owner; classify the two rows honestly and gate supported decompiler examples or fix the lifter complexity.
